title: Not sure if this was Mall World, but I was a kid....
content: So when I was a kid, my family always went camping at a campground 2 towns away, and we loved it. So I used to have this reoccurring dream that we would all be at camp in the pool. This is where it gets really weird. Remember I was like 7 or 8. So I am in the pool and I go under water and discover a door in the wall of the pool. I am somehow able to open the door and get through it, without the water coming through the door with me. I am in what seems to be a long hallway. Once I start exploring I realize I am in the game Candy Land. Like the board is open, but I am in the box? I just remeber lots of people and hallways. My child mind made it a game? Lol Idk I make my way through the game (?) not playing it, just exploring and eventually come to a door. When I get through the door, I am in my aunts garbage shed, back at her house, but everyone is still at camp and I am stuck there. I used to have that dream all the time as a kid. And a lot of my dreams include pools. I wonder why I am obsessed with pools.
